exposure: Total thyroxine (TT4) levels at 40-48 hours of age
Thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) levels at 40-48 hours of age
cohort: 3507 neonates without known risk factors for hyperbilirubinemia
finding: Idiopathic neonatal hyperbilirubinemia was associated with elevated TT4 levels (>= 13 microg/dL) and birth at 38-38.6 weeks in cesarean-delivered neonates, and with weight loss > 7.5% in vaginally delivered neonates.
mod_finding: INHB was associated with TT4 levels >= 13 microg/dL and birth at 38-38.6 weeks in cesarean-delivered neonates.
